What's New in 1.5.5-beta3:
1. Full 20-Theme & Pure Black OLED Sync:
   - Regenerated KuroTheme12.TABLE (158 palette rows across all 20 accents) after Watch Screen v3 & 1.5.x UI patches, plus runtime HLS fallback (remapDynamic) and expanded Pure Black OLED floor/card mappings.
   - Live Watch Screen v3 re-theming (watchRetheme155 & WatchHeader.refreshTheme155) when switching themes or Pure Black OLED mode from the profile menu while a video is open.
   - Dynamic kuro.tv wordmark re-hueing across both WebView SVG logos (theme-accent-1.1.js) and native WatchHeader PNG bitmaps (KuroTheme12.tintLogoBitmap).
   - Eliminated hue-wheel drift on subtle tinted borders/surfaces in theme_gen.py across all 20 theme-*.css files and added pre-color-mix CSS variable fallbacks for older Android WebViews.
2. Episode Thumbnail Fixes & Watch Screen v3 Clarity Upgrade:
   - Fixed initial episode playlist thumbnail race before playerLayer window attachment, widened artwork host allowlist (TMDB, Metahub, Kitsu,Simkl, MyAnimeList, AniDB, HiAnime/AniWatch CDNs), and added coverImage fallback.
   - Quick Episode Action Strip (< Prev • Episode • Next > + Auto-Next), compact SUB | DUB Server Switcher, upgraded 3-row Episode Playlist, and Classic Video Player preserved.
